## Execution and limits

**Public FROG / target Runtime:** not declared available by this authoring contract.

Scope: `requires_explicit_target_capability`.

Unconditional authoring availability is not claimed. The private native compiled String service declares frog.studio.string.normalize_end_of_line.bytes.v1 for scalar byte Strings and the existing U16 line_ending enum 0..4. CRLF, lone CR and LF are normalized; other bytes including NUL remain unchanged. No Array/Cluster lifting. Actual target admission is required; see docs/contracts/native-string-trim-normalize.md.
